description:
Brand Introduction:
Petdecorart is a brand dedicated to creating handmade, customized pet-themed decorations that celebrate the bond between pets and their owners. Founded in 2022, we focus on crafting unique, high-quality items that preserve the love and memories shared with beloved pets. Our skilled artisans ensure every piece is a work of art that tells a personal story.

Product Description:
Petdecorart offers three main product lines:

  • Wool Felt Custom Creations: Handmade 3D wool-felt sculptures and flat wool portraits, meticulously crafted to resemble your pet.
  • Custom Pet Oil Paintings: Classic, hand-painted portraits that beautifully capture your pet's personality.
  • Pet-Themed Wreaths: Charming, seasonal decorations featuring pet motifs, perfect for any occasion or home décor.

Unique Selling Point (USP):

  • 100% Handmade: Every product is individually crafted by skilled artisans with attention to detail.
  • Customization: Each piece is tailored to reflect the unique features of your pet, making it a truly personal keepsake.
  • Premium Quality Materials: We use high-quality wool, paints, and sustainable materials to create long-lasting products.

Payment Terms:

  • We accept major credit cards, PayPal, and other secure online payment methods.
  • For custom orders, full payment is required upon order confirmation.

Other Information:

  • Global Shipping: We deliver to a wide range of countries with standard and VIP shipping options.
  • Customer Support: Our dedicated team is available to answer queries and provide updates on orders.
  • Social Responsibility: 10% of our proceeds are donated to stray animal rescue initiatives, supporting homeless pets in need.

At Petdecorart, we strive to create meaningful, timeless pieces that celebrate the love we share with our pets.

As an affiliate, you'll receive a 10% commission for every successful referral. By joining us, you'll be part of a mission to bring joy to pet lovers while promoting one-of-a-kind, personalized art pieces.

We look forward to working with you to share our passion for pets and artistry!1
